candidates.structural_interaction: Fire directing Metal broadly — warmth applied to precision as distributed material
candidates.k2_overview: Your Metal moves as the Horizon: an edge pointed outward. You mint opportunity, spotting value with an assayer’s eye and striking while metal is hot. Deals sharpen you, markets read like open books, and money is a tool you handle without trembling. Fortune favors your precision. Fence one treasury it cannot touch.

k2_functional.mind: You think in valuations: what this is worth, to whom, and when the price moves.
k2_functional.expression: You pitch cleanly: terms polished, numbers ready, a handshake worth filing.
k2_functional.order: You keep a light code with hard edges: few laws, brightly kept, and everything else negotiable by noon.
k2_functional.action: You strike opportunities with timing others envy: measured approach, decisive cut.
k2_functional.body: Your energy is transactional and crisp: peaks in negotiations, restored by order.

k2_domain_readings.Opportunity: You see openings as clearly as flaws in ore: the undervalued asset, the mispriced moment. Trust the eye and audit the appetite. Two ventures cut deep beat ten scratched shallow.
k2_domain_readings.Ventures: Your ventures favor precision plays: quality arbitrage, timing trades, craft turned to commerce. Structure each like a blade, defined edge, clean handle, known length, and your record stays enviable.
k2_domain_readings.Father: The father-thread in your chart carries metal: a paternal figure of standards, trade, or discipline whose mark shows in how you value things. Settle those accounts. Honor or forgiveness both count as payment.
